purpose: Design: does training-time masking of LIRF's ADS-B-matched rows make the LIRF tree ens_v22_lirf_q (1/4 LightGBM group, 3/4 CatBoost group) better on LIRF rows without ADS-B, the regime of July 2026 (15,515 dark LIRF non-population rows, where v54 gives the tree share 0.25 and v45's u600 gate leans to it)?

disclosed_motivation.thinning_measurement: Before this declaration (label-reading on the development month July 2025 only): on the 13,907 July 2025 LIRF non-population rows that are matched naturally and unmatched after thinning to July 2026's coverage (coverage-regime attempt a13, labels below 20,000 s), the seasonal-fold ens_v22_lirf_q goes 412.96 -> 440.70 s RMSE (worse than v9's 434.7 s), the shipped LIRF network ens_ctx_lirf 429.92 -> 435.70 s; the v34 unmatched blend at share 0.583 410.0 -> 422.9 s and at 0.75 415.9 -> 425.5 s.
disclosed_motivation.match_shares: LIRF ADS-B match share of departures (label-free): 2025-01..04 0.00, 05 0.10, 06 0.60, 07 0.94, 08 0.89, 09 0.42, 10 0.63, 11 0.66; ranking 2026-01 0.80, 2026-07 0.00. The trees' unmatched LIRF fitting rows are mostly January-April plus partial June / September.
disclosed_motivation.neighbour_encoding: Label-free, read before this declaration: LIRF rows in July 2026 (ranking) carry the three neighbour counts 0 (100%) and NaN in the other neighbour columns (99.3%); July 2025 thinned (a13) the same (counts 0, medians 89-96% NaN); January 2025 (no LIRF ground data at all) carries NaN in every neighbour column; naturally matched July 2025 rows carry counts of about 7-23. prc2026_tree_mask.augment's focal masking keeps neighbour columns, so its masked copies do not look like July 2026's LIRF rows; the 'dark' semantics below sets the neighbour columns to July 2026's encoding.
disclosed_motivation.earlier_designs: docs/tree_mask (1 October): focal masking of the committee's trees, LIRF left out of fitting, null on non-LIRF unmatched rows. docs/adsb_ctx3_lirf (1 October): masking the LIRF context network helped LIRF's unmatched rows in every month, most where LIRF is dark.
disclosed_motivation.deviation_from_brief: The brief asked for focal p 0.5 on all seven learners; the neighbour-encoding reading above (before any fit) moved the CatBoost group to the 'dark' semantics; focal is kept for the LightGBM group (p 0.25 and 0.5) so both semantics are read at equal footing there.

fold: seasonal (fit 2025-02..06, 08, 09; early stopping 2025-10; score 2025-01 + 2025-07), the original learners' own fold; identical kind, target, seed, parameters (thread count aside), round cap, patience, label cap, LIRF fill population excluded, matches data/external/adsblol/matches, timeline bundle ce42240e...

masking.rows: LIRF non-population fitting rows with adsb_matched = 1 (every other row and every early-stopping / score row untouched)
masking.weights: each masked row keeps weight 1 - p and gains a copy with weight p (static expectation of a per-step draw)
masking.focal: the 15 focal ADS-B columns of the learner contract NaN, adsb_matched 0 (what every unmatched row carries); neighbour columns unchanged
masking.dark: focal, plus nb_runway_10m_count / nb_airport_10m_count / nb_runway_30m_count = 0 and the other eight neighbour columns NaN (July 2026's LIRF encoding)

threads: 8 per fit for every run, controls included (two lanes per worker); the originals used 16, so the controls measure refit noise including the thread count
hardware: Azure arcw0-arcw3, two lanes per worker; each worker deallocated right after its hash-checked mirror. No GPU, no AWS.

dark50_all.rule: ens_v22_lirf_q's own leaf list (LightGBM leaves x4, CatBoost leaves x9, nan-mean) with each named learner replaced by its run

dark50_lgb.rule: ens_v22_lirf_q's own leaf list (LightGBM leaves x4, CatBoost leaves x9, nan-mean) with each named learner replaced by its run

focal50_lgb.rule: ens_v22_lirf_q's own leaf list (LightGBM leaves x4, CatBoost leaves x9, nan-mean) with each named learner replaced by its run

focal25_lgb.rule: ens_v22_lirf_q's own leaf list (LightGBM leaves x4, CatBoost leaves x9, nan-mean) with each named learner replaced by its run

control_reading.use: refit noise: the same reading as a candidate, with the two unmasked refits in their slots

readings.tree_prime: tree' = the set's tree + (candidate ensemble - saved seasonal ens_v22_lirf_q), both predicted on the set's own inputs (natural seasonal predictions for January 2025 and natural July; the a13 thinned frame for thinned July, re-predicted with prc2026_december.scoring.learner_prediction on LIRF rows; the saved ensemble re-predicted the same way must reproduce runs/coverage_regime/measure/2025-07/predictions.parquet 'thinned:ens_v22_lirf_q' within 0.01 s RMS before any candidate is read).
readings.sets: tools/run_lirf_dark.build_sets(): thinned_july (July 2025 LIRF non-population rows unmatched after a13 thinning; tree = the seasonal-fold thinned ensemble) and natural:2025-01 (all LIRF non-population rows, unmatched; its tree is the leave-one-month-out ens_v22_lirf_q, so the seasonal-fold masking delta is added to it: a declared approximation); natural July descriptive only; November / December have no seasonal-fold prediction and are not read.
readings.values: v54's dark arithmetic (tools/run_lirf_dark.values): network' = 0.30 ens_ctx_lirf + 0.70 M (16 lm25_32 seeds), blend 0.75 network' + 0.25 tree', gate u600 (tree' - network' > 600 s: v9 0 / network' 0.2 / tree' 0.8), floor -12. Control = the same with the saved tree.
readings.metric: tools/run_lirf_dark.compare: primary = route rows with labels below 20,000 s, relative SSE change with a paired-day 95% interval (10,000 draws, seed 20261001); unfiltered reported.
readings.descriptive: standalone tree RMSE (saved vs candidate) on the route rows, natural and thinned; natural July matched LIRF rows (harm on matched rows); the least-squares tree share for each candidate on thinned July and January 2025.

go_rule: A candidate is GO when (1) thinned July's primary change is at most -0.5% with its interval below zero, (2) January 2025's primary change is at most 0, and (3) thinned July's change is below -2 x |the control reading's thinned July change|. GO leads to a separately declared development round (leave-one-month-out January and July, forward, refit, refit12 fits, read inside the stack); a design result never ships.
never_read: No official score, ranking label or published aggregate. Ranking feature encodings (label-free) were read for the neighbour semantics.
